description_en: Creates a copy of a file or folder in a cloud drive
description_zh: 为网盘中的文件或文件夹制作一个副本
kebab_example: aliyun ecd copy-cds-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cds-id cn-hangzhou+cds-3522820000 --file-id 640985a0ca2f71f489d2497682ca0bf468de0000 --parent-folder-id root --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CopyCdsFile

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html to query the ID of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who is logged on to the cloud drive
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent folder at the destination. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html to query the ID of the folder. Set this parameter to `root` if you want to copy the file or folder to the root directory
parameters.help_zh: 复制目的地位置的父文件夹ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2247622.html接口查询对应文件的ID。当复制进根目录时，填0
parameters.name: parent_folder_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically rename the file when a file with the same name already exists in the destination folder
parameters.help_zh: 当目标文件夹下存在同名文件时，是否自动重命名
parameters.name: auto_rename

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the personal drive (which can be obtained from the UserId response parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357237.html operation) or the team space ID (which can be obtained from the GroupId response parameter of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609896.html operation) at the destination.
If both FileReceiverId and FileReceiverType are empty, the file is copied to the personal drive where the file currently resides by default
parameters.help_zh:
复制目的地所在的个人盘ID（可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357237.html接口的返回参数0获取）或者团队空间ID（可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/609896.html接口的返回参数1获取）。
`FileReceiverId`和`FileReceiverType`都为空时，默认复制到文件当前所在的个人盘
parameters.name: file_receiver_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the space to which the file belongs
parameters.name: file_receiver_type

Code.description_en: The execution result. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

CopyCdsFileModel.description_en: The result of the file copy operation

AsyncTaskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID. This field is not returned when a file is copied. When a folder is copied, the copy operation is performed asynchronously in the background, so this field is returned. You can call [GetAsyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357404.html） and pass in this asynchronous task ID to obtain the task details
AsyncTaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。当复制文件时，不返回该字段；当复制文件夹时，因为是后台异步复制，所以会返回该字段，调用[GetAsyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2357404.html）并传入该异步任务ID即可获取任务详细信息

FileId.description_en: The ID of the new file or folder after the copy operation
FileId.description_zh: 复制后的新文件或文件夹ID

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if Code is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful
